note: Real. Scored by analysis/statistics/checks.py against the written rules in research/predictions.md.

checks.name: Aqua's look time over each Brazilian biome rises every year 2021-2025; VIIRS stays flat
checks.detail: Reading (a) 2022-2025 each >= prior year: 6/6 biomes. Reading (b) also 2021 >= 2020: 3/6 (amazon 2021 vs 2020: -0.7 min; cerrado 2021 vs 2020: -0.9 min; pantanal 2021 vs 2020: -0.6 min). S-NPP within 10 min of 2012-2020 every year: 6/6. Readings disagree: the team must pick one in research/predictions.md before this is scored.
checks.rule_written: Each year ≥ the year before; VIIRS within ±10 min of 2012 to 2020
checks.rule_implemented: Median near-nadir local solar time per biome and year (FIRMS); both readings of 'every year' reported.

checks.name: Punjab Aqua look time follows Jethva 2026 (1:44 PM in 2021 to 3:12 PM in 2025)
checks.detail: Aqua later every year 2021-2025: yes; total rise 76 min (rule 60-120). Our absolute times run 27-39 min earlier than Jethva's; time convention not yet checked.
checks.rule_written: Same direction each year; total rise 60 to 120 min
checks.rule_implemented: As written, on the preset Punjab + Haryana bbox, all months.

checks.name: Our FIRMS Aqua data reproduces INPE's reference counts
checks.detail: Biome-months 2012-2020 within 10% of INPE: 96.6% with all daytime Aqua detections, 81.6% with the plan's type and confidence filters. Rule: >= 90%. Study period: 2021-2025 337/360 (93.6%), 2025 63/72 (87.5%). INPE uses the same NASA/UMD MODIS algorithm, so this shows we track the intended series; it is not an independent check of individual fires.
checks.rule_implemented: Scored with all daytime detections; the written rule names no filter, and the filtered count misses the threshold.

checks.name: Day-to-day sampling noise explains the pre-drift wobble
checks.detail: Placebo years (2012-2020, each held out) whose 95% day-bootstrap interval contains 1: amazon 8/9, cerrado 9/9, caatinga 9/9, mata_atlantica 9/9, pantanal 9/9, pampa 9/9. Rule: >= 7/9. With the 16-day block bootstrap used elsewhere: amazon 7/9, cerrado 9/9, caatinga 8/9, mata_atlantica 8/9, pantanal 7/9, pampa 8/9. Nine placebo years give a coarse range: a tenth exchangeable year would fall outside the first nine's min-max about 20% of the time.
checks.rule_written: The day-bootstrap interval of each placebo year's L (2012 to 2020, one year held out at a time) contains 1 in at least 7 of 9 years. **If it fails:** use the placebo range (min to max of the 9 values) as the uncertainty for 2021 to 2025. Either way, a post-2021 L counts as a detection only if it falls **outside** the placebo range
checks.rule_implemented: As written (day bootstrap); block-bootstrap result shown alongside.

checks.name: Fire-size mix doesn't explain the audit
checks.detail: Sensitivity to daily mean S-NPP FRP: L_strat (days split into FRP terciles, reweighted to the 2012-2020 mix) inside L's 95% interval in 29/29 biome-years 2021-2025. Largest move 0.084; Amazon 2025 moves from 1.296 to 1.212. Daily mean FRP is a weak proxy for fire size; this is not a direct size test.
checks.rule_implemented: Per-day FRP classes, because the daily file has no per-detection FRP.

checks.name: VIIRS is a stable clock
checks.detail: L with S-NPP as reference inside the 95% interval of L with NOAA-20 in 30/30 biome-years 2021-2025, both on days when Aqua, S-NPP and NOAA-20 all returned data and on a 2018-2020 baseline. Paired difference S-NPP minus NOAA-20: median -0.002, largest 0.112; its interval excludes 0 in 1/30. Both references are VIIRS and share the Aqua numerator, so this cannot detect a bias common to both.
checks.rule_written: L with an S-NPP reference within the interval of L with a NOAA-20 reference
checks.rule_implemented: As written, on a common availability mask. An earlier version admitted days when S-NPP was down and tested the reverse direction.

checks.name: Closure: the timing slope predicts the observed L
checks.detail: L_pred inside the 90% interval of L in 16/23 strict biome-years (70%; rule >= 75%). beta = log(Aqua/Terra) per hour of look-time gap, 2012-2020 (same MODIS sensor, same days). Misses: amazon 2023 (pred 1.12, obs 1.01), amazon 2024 (pred 1.29, obs 1.10), cerrado 2024 (pred 1.10, obs 1.18), caatinga 2024 (pred 1.21, obs 1.47), mata_atlantica 2023 (pred 1.10, obs 1.02), mata_atlantica 2024 (pred 1.24, obs 1.18), pantanal 2024 (pred 1.10, obs 0.97).
checks.rule_written: L_pred inside the 90% interval of observed L in at least 75% of strict-test biome-years (biomes × years where Aqua's shift ≤ 1 hour)
checks.rule_implemented: As written; beta from the 2012-2020 log(Aqua/Terra) slope per hour.

checks.name: VIIRS detects small real fires better than MODIS
checks.detail: a50 (fire size detected half the time), 2012-2020: S-NPP 319 acres [271.0, 375.1], Aqua 946 acres [777.2, 1168.0]. Not pre-registered (computed before the commit). These describe one matching procedure for isolated, agency-recorded California fires, not universal sensor limits.
checks.rule_written: a50(VIIRS) < a50(Aqua), with intervals not overlapping
checks.rule_implemented: As written, on FPA-FOD California fires 2012-2020.

checks.name: Opposite drifts move the Terra and Aqua probes in opposite directions
checks.detail: Pass in 4/6 biomes with beta > 0: amazon A up, T down; cerrado A up, T down; caatinga A up, T down; mata_atlantica A up, T down; pantanal A not monotone, T not monotone; pampa A up, T not monotone. Deviation: the written gate uses VIIRS same-day pairs, but S-NPP and NOAA-20 look at the same local time (13:31 vs 13:31 over the Amazon in 2024), so that slope cannot be measured. Gate used: the MODIS Terra/Aqua slope beta.
checks.rule_written: In each region where VIIRS same-day pairs show fire rising after 1:30 PM (β > 0): A_y rises and T_y falls (2023 to 2025)
checks.rule_implemented: Deviates from the written gate: MODIS Terra/Aqua slope instead of VIIRS same-day pairs.

checks.name: The two-clock difference agrees with the audit
checks.detail: Clock share of log A_y = clock_diff x dA/(dA - dT) inside the 95% interval of log L_y in 15/23 biome-years 2022-2025 (65%; rule >= 75%). Misses: amazon 2025, cerrado 2025, caatinga 2024, mata_atlantica 2024, mata_atlantica 2025, pantanal 2023, pantanal 2024, pampa 2023.
checks.rule_written: The clock share of log A_y from the difference method lies inside the bootstrap interval of log L_y in ≥ 75% of biome-years 2022 to 2025
checks.rule_implemented: Clock share defined here as clock_diff x dA/(dA - dT); the plan's own definition is not in the repo.
